model_output.verdict: A senior payments engineer whose resume connects technical decisions to measurable improvements.
write_up: This is a strong resume! Your work at Tidewater Commerce and Northwind Billing shows a senior engineer who can build payment systems, lead an audit and make services more reliable. The best results are tied to the technical work behind them.
The ledger line is a great model: it names the service you built and the drop in reconciliation breaks. The billing dashboards are the one place I'd want a little more detail about what they tracked.

Start there, then consider bringing the ledger result to the top of the Tidewater role. Your resume isn't likely to be what stands between you and a call back; how competitive the job is will matter too.
